$comment: DCAT harvest feeds — read by scripts/generate-dcat.ts (runs on predev/prebuild). Configured by /portaljs-add-dcat. `profiles` selects which application profiles to emit (dcat-2, dcat-3, dcat-ap, dcat-us, geodcat-ap, croissant, or a national profile id like dcat-ap-se/ch/de/it — register more via registerDcatProfile). `serializations` picks the RDF formats (croissant emits JSON-LD only regardless). The rest is the catalog-level org/contact metadata DCAT-AP and DCAT-US require: fill `publisher` and `contactPoint` before claiming conformance (the generator warns which mandatory fields are still missing). DCAT-US requires an IRI-identified publisher: set `publisher.uri` (or `publisher.homepage`, used as the fallback @id) or the publisher is rejected as a blank node. GeoDCAT-AP reads spatial coverage from each dataset's `dcat.spatial` (bbox/geometry WKT) or the catalog-wide `spatial` key here. DCAT-AP_IT (dcat-ap-it) also needs `publisher.identifier` (the IPA code of the publishing administration — VAT number for a private body), EU data themes (`themes`), and a licence on every dataset (`licenses` in datasets.json, or `license` here); per dataset it reads `dcat.rightsHolder` ({name, identifier, homepage}; defaults to the publisher) and `dcat.accrualPeriodicity` (EU frequency token or IRI; defaults to UNKNOWN). Other profiles ignore these fields.
